subject: English Home Language

show.line: Slow, slowly. Quick, quickly. Add an ending to say how. Baby, babies. Fly, flies. More than one!

rounds.prompt: The snail moves, gap. Which word fits?
rounds.praise: Slowly! It tells how the snail moves.

rounds.prompt: One baby. Here are two. Say the word for more than one baby.
One fly. Here are three. Say the word.
The girl sings, gap. Which word tells how she sings?
Tells how, or more than one? Put each word in its group.

hints: Does the word tell how something is done? Slowly, quickly.
More than one baby? The ending changes. Babies.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! One puppy. Here are two. I will say the word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! More than one puppy is puppies, like babies.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. One puppy, two puppies!

parent_line: Can read and use words ending in ly, like slowly, and ies, like babies.
